payload.name: Resolve bare month or season year from memory context
payload.description: When a question asks what someone did or visited in a month or season without a year, use the person's memory timeline to pick the year and search non-temporally first, instead of assuming the session year.
content: When a question time reference is a bare month or season (e.g., 'in May', 'last spring') without a year, do not use only the session timestamp to set the date range. First run a broad non-temporal search for the person and activity (with synonyms) to surface candidate memories, then check the month/season of each candidate.

If the broad search returns no candidate for the requested month, run a structured temporal search using the session year; if that yields no memory overlapping the month, retry once with the previous year (or the most frequent year in the person's retrieved memories) before concluding no evidence exists.
Accept a memory as evidence only if its world_start/world_end overlaps the requested month/season in one of the tried years; ignore memories whose month does not match even if other keywords align.
Stop after at most two temporal year attempts plus one non-temporal search; do not expand to exhaustive year sweeps.

solves: Questions that reference a month or season with no year often fail because the agent builds the date range from the current/session year, while the person's relevant memories are from an earlier year. The skill forces a broad non-temporal search first and then a small set of plausible-year temporal searches so the right memory can be found without exhaustive year scanning.
